definitions.explanation: The second of a series of stages or rounds, or something derived from or following on from a primary thing. Usually the first part of a compound: {二次会|にじかい}, {二次|にじ}{試験|しけん}, {二次|にじ}{災害|さいがい}.

examples.japanese: {二次会|にじかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
{二次|にじ}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧です。
examples.english: The second-round exam is an interview.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二次|にじ}⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: After an earthquake, watch out for secondary disasters.

notes:
Pairs with ⟦{一次|いちじ}→一次：31138_ichiji⟧ (first, primary). {二次会|にじかい}, the second round of a party at another venue, is the compound learners hear most.

COMPOUNDS:
- {二次会|にじかい}: after-party, second party
- {二次|にじ}⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧ / {二次|にじ}⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧: second-round exam / interview
- {二次|にじ}⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧: secondary disaster (fires, landslides after an earthquake)
- {二次|にじ}{元|げん}: two-dimensional; (slang) anime and manga characters
- {第二次|だいにじ}{世界大戦|せかいたいせん}: World War II

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{虹|にじ}→虹：03894_niji⟧ (rainbow) and {二時|にじ} (two o'clock) share the reading
